meta.title: Night shift
meta.description: A schedule read at 02:00, where the current shift started at 20:00 the day before.

scenario: The time is 02:00, the shifts are twelve hours long and anchored at 08:00, so the shift being read started at 20:00 the previous evening and ends at 08:00 this morning. A schedule that treats the day as midnight to midnight breaks here; this one does not.
look: The current shift crosses midnight: it runs from 20:00 yesterday to 08:00 today, and its items are on both sides of the date change.
The now indicator is at 02:00, six hours into the shift rather than two hours into the day.
The headings stay relative — previous, current, next. Which shift is current comes from the clock, not from the calendar.
Nothing here is a setting for night work: the same anchor and the same length place every shift, at any hour.
